verdict.rationale: Choosing entity type and jurisdiction is a fair question for a law firm with a venture practice, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Gide advising on financing transactions "from fundraising to exit" and "from seed capital to IPOs," plus a network of 11 offices. Nothing in the pack shows published guidance comparing entity types (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) or how to choose a jurisdiction of incorporation.
